entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane whose five shards, once separate worlds each flowing with three colors of mana, have converged into one plane flowing with all five colors.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara: an orderly, sunlit kingdom defended in the name of its guardian angels.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara: a hegemony of wizards and sphinxes whose forces seek carmot to create more etherium.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara: an undead-infested hellscape whose hordes assault other shards.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara: a primordial hunting-ground ruled by dragons.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara: a lush jungle paradise whose forces follow the elves' decrees.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker who planned the convergence of Alara to feed on its mana and restore his lost power.

entities.name: Carmot
entities.description: An element Esper needs to create more of its dwindling etherium.

entities.name: The Anima
entities.description: Source of prophetic visions that Naya's forces march out of the jungle to answer.

events.summary: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.
events.quote: But now they have converged into one, and the rejoined plane flows with all five colors of mana once more.

events.summary: As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards.
events.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolve, cultures clash and wars ensue.

events.summary: Esper's forces invade the other shards looking for carmot.
events.quote: The forces of Esper invade the other shards looking for carmot, an element necessary to create more of their dwindling etherium.

events.summary: Grixis undead assault other shards to maim, enslave and drain life energy.
events.quote: Hordes of Grixis undead mount an assault to maim, enslave, and drain the life energy from other shards.

events.summary: Naya's forces march out of the jungle searching for answers to the Anima's visions, and Bant's armies fight the horrors crossing their borders.
events.quote: And the armies of Bant clash with the horrors swarming over their borders, defending their homeland in the name of their guardian angels.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas, who planned the convergence all along, came to Alara to feed on its mana and restore its lost power in one massive ritual.
events.quote: He came to Alara to feed on its rich mana and, in one massive ritual, restore its lost power as part of his multiplanar plan.

relations.quote: The five shards of Alara were separate worlds for centuries

relations.note: Esper invades the other shards, and the shards' legions pummel one another.
relations.quote: At each front, the shards' legions pummel one another with powerful magics

relations.note: Bolas planned the convergence of Alara and came to feed on its mana.
relations.quote: Nicol Bolas, the ancient dragon Planeswalker, planned this all along.
